what: WP3b round 4: rule for replacing the current registration defaults with round 4. Sealed 2026-10-29 before any round-4 evaluation.
setting: Round 3's net, unchanged (runs/wp3b/warpnet_r3/e1000/last.pt; no retraining, so no epoch pilot) + Params.net_fill=True + Params.unfold_iters=50 (new: repair of folded voxels in the written maps) + SVF last stage only svf_stages=[[2,4,150]], svf_class_weights={'brain': 0}, w_init 0. Scored by scripts/eval_warpnet.py --unfold 50 --rule wp3b_r4_adopt on the 30 validation cases (runs/wp3b/warpnet_r4/eval_val).
disclosure: Round 3's whole-cap validation results for this net are known (not adopted: EEG worst point 14.93 mm, 1/30 folded). Its rTMS-set results were not computed before this rule was sealed. The unfold mechanism was checked on PIT30 only (written-map fold removed, points moved <= 0.17 mm). EEG scope per the sealed gate rule wp3_gate_rtms_set (user, 2026-10-29).
baseline: current defaults on the same 30 validation cases (runs/wp3b/warpnet/decision.json baseline, baseline_val_projected.json): targets mean 1.6309 / max 5.0285; EEG rTMS set (F3, F4, Fz, Fpz, Fp1, Fp2, Cz, C3, C4, FCz, T7, T8, Oz) on charm's skin mean 2.2816 / max 9.0875; fiducials on charm's skin max 9.8477.
rule: Adopt (then run it once on the 57 frozen test cases, judged by the gate rule wp3_gate_rtms_set, then once on the OASIS-1 rescan set, counted as a second use) only if ALL hold: (1) targets mean <= 1.5809 (baseline - 0.05 mm); (2) EEG rTMS set on charm's skin mean <= 2.2316 (baseline - 0.05 mm); (3) no worst point worse than baseline by more than 1 mm: targets max <= 6.0285, EEG rTMS set on charm's skin max <= 10.0875, fiducials on charm's skin max <= 10.8477; (4) no folding (below). Otherwise the defaults stay and the test set is not scored.
no_folding: written-map min Jacobian > 0 in both MNI2Conform_nonl and Conform2MNI_nonl on every one of the 30 validation cases (eval_warpnet summary cases_no_fold == 30), measured after the unfold repair.
gate_note: Adoption is not the WP3 gate: the gate (wp3_gate_rtms_set) is judged on the test run.
